rationale: This paper qualifies under category (a) and (d) because it explicitly addresses the core mechanism of "hierarchical prediction error minimization" and "predictive processing" in cognitive architecture, providing a formal generative framework that is directly relevant to the theoretical underpinnings of implementing such systems in LLMs, even though it focuses on cognitive science rather than specific neural network code.
